name: SerikaMagia ~Outo Adult Shop-hen~
original_name: セリカマギア ～王都アダルトショップ編～
source:
Celica is a "goddess-class magician" and a student of Orleans Academy.

Engaged to her childhood friend Leon, the two promised a pure relationship until marriage, abstaining from even a kiss.

However, one year prior, Celica happened to witness a "certain thing", and from that day developed an addiction to masturbation. But lately it's gotten repetitive...

One day, Celica secretly departs by carriage, headed to the Royal Capital's adult shop.

Will Celica be able to successfully purchase her desired "goods" and make it back to Leon in Orleans county?

Or maybe...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ419055]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
塞莉卡是“女神级魔法师”，奥尔良学园的学生。

与她儿时的朋友莱昂订婚后，两人承诺在结婚前保持纯洁的关系，甚至不接吻。

然而，在一年前，塞莉卡偶然目睹了“某件事”，从那天起，她就染上了手淫的瘾。但最近又开始重复了…

某一天，瑟莉卡偷偷乘坐马车出发，前往王都的成人用品店。

塞莉卡能否成功购买到她想要的“商品”并返回奥尔良县的莱昂呢？

或者也许…
